'''Star Wars CCG teams''' are standing playtest and travel groups of players who test together and show up at majors. They are separate from Decipher's 1990s volunteer [[Squadron Members]], from the Friday two-player Team Tournament format at modern majors, and from the biennial [[Outrider Cup]] geographic all-star sides.

Olson posted the Team 5 active/inactive split in Slack.<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref> Players Committee wraps still print Hayes, Joe, and Phil as Team 5 at 2025–2026 majors.

A 2026 GEMPC bracket-reveal stream also named '''Money Ball''' in the same breath as New Allies, Team 5, and Killer Bees. No public member list has been published for Money Ball.<ref name="gempc-br">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rA539EIuVm0 2026 GEMPC bracket reveal], Star Wars CCG YouTube</ref>

== Related ==

* '''[[Outrider Cup]]''' — Team Europe vs Team USA / North America, seeded from Player of the Year points and captain's picks.
* '''Friday Team Tournament''' — two-player Light/Dark pairs at majors (for example 2025 Worlds team "Scott Norwood": [[Brian Fred]] and [[Jonny Chu]]).
* '''[[Squadron Members]]''' — Decipher volunteer promoters (Red, Gold, Bravo, Rogue), not competitive playtest rosters.
